title: skills: teach an aggregate bulk handler to resolve with BulkActionResult (skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md)
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQjrEpxMVxEiDUJHqC

Follow-up from PR #34267 (card #34216, seat ruling 6905490575). That PR declares `BulkActionResultSchema` in `@objectstack/spec/ui`, with the shape `{ succeeded: string[], failed: { id, message }[] }`. It is the whole resolve value of an `execution: 'aggregate'` bulk handler, and it is never carried on a rejection.

**Ask (skills lane).** Once the ui reader lands (the grid follow-up of #34216, at `useBulkExecutor.ts` / `BulkActionDialog.tsx`, after #34213), update `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` to teach these points:
- An aggregate handler that moved some rows and failed others catches per row and RESOLVES with the result. It does not throw.
- A throw still means "no outcome", so the dialog shows the one-outcome report.
- Ids outside `params._selectedIds` are dropped.
- A return value with neither `succeeded` nor `failed` keeps today's report. A value that carries either member but does not parse is reported "unreadable", never as full success (seat ruling amended at review r2 6907153374, see the amendment on #34216).
- Ids counting: a duplicate counts once, an id in both lists counts as failed, and a selected id in neither list is "not confirmed".

Until the reader lands, teaching this would advertise an answer the console does not render.

Blocked-by: #34269
